name: Dart
overview: The Bible presents darts as light javelins, weapons that can be both literal and figurative. In Numbers 25:7, Phinehas takes a javelin in hand, illustrating the dart as a physical weapon. Job 41:29 uses darts metaphorically, comparing them to stubble, highlighting their seeming insignificance against true power. Ephesians 6:16 applies the image figuratively to spiritual warfare, describing how faith can quench the fiery darts of the wicked, emphasizing the believer's protection through faith against spiritual attacks.
